_comment: The head this provenance index is projected onto. Changing it is a deliberate act: it redefines which verdicts are authoritative, so it is versioned beside the register rather than passed on a command line.
final_door_4_fix_subject: fix(readiness): the dispatch gate is an allow-list, not a deny-list
authority_rule: A catalogued verdict is AUTHORITATIVE for the frozen head when (1) no succession-register entry names it as `previous`, (2) its subject_sha is known, (3) that sha is an ancestor of the frozen head, and (4) the final door-4 fix is an ancestor of that sha — i.e. the verdict was pronounced on the fix or later. A terminal verdict that fails (2), (3) or (4) is STALE-UNREPLACED: still true on its own bytes, but it does not speak for the frozen head and nothing has replaced it.
